svg.title: Figure 7. System Architecture of the Proposed System
svg.desc: Health workers use the website to keep child records, plan vaccination visits, prepare reports, and request text reminders. BHW means Barangay Health Worker.

g.text: FIGURE 7. SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE OF THE PROPOSED SYSTEM
Connected mode shown; standalone demo uses fictional local records
Runs within the website using recorded vaccine dates
Suggests unusual date patterns for staff to check
Does not assess the child's health
